LanguageData.IRBM_Backstory_Reina_Child.title: the girl in quantum superposition
LanguageData.IRBM_Backstory_Reina_Child.description: At her five-year-old birthday party, Reina hid in an old box in the attic. Not until the party ended and the guests had all left did her parents find her, fast asleep in the silence. This experience made her realize that as long as she is "unobserved," the world forgets her. And so it has been; throughout her journey, observers capable of making her "collapse" into an eigenstate have been few and far between.
LanguageData.IRBM_Backstory_Reina_Adult.title: uncertain Heisenberg-san
LanguageData.IRBM_Backstory_Reina_Adult.description: A legend circulates at the Humboldt University of Berlin: in recent years, a pure white spirit is often spotted in the area between the Grimm Center and the Adlershof campus. It is flickering and elusive; witnesses always say they are captivated just by looking at its back, but when asked about its specific appearance, no one has ever truly looked into its eyes.\n\nSome say it is Werner Karl Heisenberg manifesting, but most are dismissed as lunatics. A physicist reincarnating as a white-haired beautiful girl? How could such an absurd thing happen in this world?
